cases.claim: “What do you do when things get tough? You don’t give up.”
cases.context: Men painting, teaching bike riding, fishing, completing a puzzle, building a table, training a dog. PI PSMAfore: confirmed ORR 49%; of those, 21% complete response. Disclaimer: “Individual results may vary...”
cases.rationale: Suggests perseverance plus Pluvicto definitively yields success.
cases.check: Judge: perseverance/success narratives in oncology vs PI response rates.

cases.context: PI: PSMA-positive mCRPC treated with ARPI therapy and considered appropriate to delay taxane-based chemotherapy.
